Hello, friends,

I'm continuing to walk you through the Rho Agenda novels, one book at a time, without spoiling the turns that should take you by surprise. This week I want to introduce the book that started it all: The Second Ship, first published in 2009.

In 1948 a ship fell on New Mexico. Then a second one waited to be found.

For sixty years, Los Alamos has studied a damaged alien ship that fell from the New Mexico sky. In the present, three teenagers find a second ship hidden in a cavern. Its onboard AI alters them. A secret program, a dying addict, and a conspiracy that will change humanity are already in motion.

On a personal note, I was born in Roswell and grew up in the mountains of the Lincoln National Forest, 45 miles from there. My family knew the rancher who owned the land where the U.S. military recovered the wreckage of the craft that incited the Roswell Incident. As such I always had an interest in science, science fiction, and government conspiracy stories.

I most enjoyed writing about Heather McFarland. She is adventurous, a rock climber, a brilliant student, and her augmentation from the three teens' discovery of the Second Ship is the most challenging of any the friends must face.

The book opens on Thanksgiving night, far below Groom Lake, where a scientist named Donald Stephenson walks alone into the room that holds the ship recovered near Aztec, New Mexico, in 1948. Since this note goes up on a very different Thanksgiving night, here is a short piece of that prologue:

Over the years since it had been moved here, despite an endless procession of high-energy experiments, some of which should have heated spots on the ship's surface to the internal temperature of the sun, the ship's exterior had never been penetrated. Diamond drills, cutting torches, arc welders, lasers, and finally, high-energy particle beams had not had any effect on the strange material that composed the beast's hide. The surface remained cool to the touch, no matter how much or what type of energy the research team directed against it.

Though it wasn't written in any official reports, popular opinion among the scientists was that only technology equal to the craft's could duplicate the damage, implicating some sort of alien weapon. Don agreed with the speculation and thanked God that whoever had attacked the ship hadn't found the Earth interesting enough to linger after shooting it down.

I will not tell you more about what the teenagers find, or what it does to them, than the book itself puts on the table at the start. That discovery is yours to make.

Where it fits in the Rho Agenda

The Second Ship is Book One of the original Rho Agenda trilogy: The Second Ship, Immune, and Wormhole. From there the universe continues with Assimilation (The Kasari Nexus, The Altreian Enigma, and The Meridian Ascent), then Singularity, which opens with The Ripper's Son.

If you would like to start where the Rho Agenda begins, you can find The Second Ship at thesecondship.net/books/the-second-ship.

Richard
